faqs.q: How long does a typical software development project take?
faqs.a: Timelines depend on scope and complexity. Smaller projects usually take 2 to 4 weeks, while larger custom software solutions typically take 8 to 12 weeks from discovery to launch.

faqs.q: What is the process when I book a free demo?
faqs.a: You book a short call, share your goals, and we walk you through relevant solutions. Afterwards, you receive tailored recommendations and a clear proposal for your project.

faqs.q: Will I receive regular updates during development?
faqs.a: Yes. We work in agile sprints and share weekly progress updates, so you always know what has been completed, what comes next, and how your project is progressing.

faqs.q: Do you provide support after the project is delivered?
faqs.a: Yes. After launch, we offer ongoing maintenance, performance monitoring, bug fixes, and feature enhancements to keep your software secure, stable, and ready to scale with your business.
